title: 👜Come to Work With Me & Clover! 🐶| Decluttering and Organizing
description:
In this video, Clover and I go to an organizing client's apartment in Back Bay in Boston to organize and declutter a kitchen, guest room, and bedroom. When you are a professional organizer, some jobs are more casual and a lot of fun! This is one of my favorite home organizing clients and I am very grateful to her for letting me film some parts of our session. I hope you enjoy this video!
